population.kidComparison: Around 114 million people live here—almost everyone lives along the green ribbon of the Nile River.

geography.climate: Hot, sunny desert climate with very little rain, cooled along the Mediterranean coast and the Nile valley.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

flag.description: Horizontal stripes of red, white, and black with a golden eagle emblem in the center.

anthem.title: Bilady, Bilady, Bilady
anthem.summary: Means 'My Homeland, My Homeland, My Homeland,' celebrating loyalty to Egypt.

exploration.didYouKnow: The Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest human-made structure on Earth for over 3,800 years!

regionalTraits: Decodes ancient hieroglyph symbols for fun
